title: Apple rescues Hide My Email feature from the privacy scrap heap | TechCrunch
summary: Hide My Email is a privacy feature for paying iCloud+ users that generates a unique and disposable email address to give websites instead of a person’s real email address and still have emails route to their regular inboxes.
